props.gloss_en: up to how much does one make a zimmun? up to an olive-bulk
R' Yehuda: up to an egg-bulk
one who left Jerusalem and remembered he had sacred meat in hand: if he passed Tzofim he burns it where he is; if not, he goes back and burns it before the Bira with wood of the altar pile
how much must they have to go back? R' Meir: for this and for that, an egg-bulk
R' Yehuda: for this and for that, an olive-bulk
R' Yochanan: the attributions [in one of the two mishnayot] are reversed
Abaye: do not reverse -- both mishnayot stand as attributed
R' Meir (per Abaye): 'and you shall eat' is eating, 'and be satisfied' is drinking -- and eating is an olive-bulk
R' Yehuda (per Abaye): 'and you shall eat and be satisfied' is eating that satisfies -- and which is that? an egg-bulk
R' Meir (per Abaye): its return is like its impurity -- as its impurity is at an egg-bulk, so its return
R' Yehuda (per Abaye): its return is like its prohibition -- as its prohibition is at an olive-bulk, so its return

רבי יהודה סבר: ואכלת ושבעת -- אכילה שיש בה שביעה, ואיזו זו כביצה
חזרתו כטומאתו: מה טומאתו בכביצה, אף חזרתו בכביצה
חזרתו כאיסורו: מה איסורו בכזית, אף חזרתו בכזית

objections.gloss_en: למימרא דרבי מאיר חשיב ליה כזית? והא איפכא שמעינן להו, דתנן: עד כמה הם חוזרים? רבי מאיר אומר זה וזה בכביצה

answered_by.gloss_en: מוחלפת השיטה -- the attributions are reversed (= p_muchlefet_hashita)
לעולם לא תיפוך: הכא בקראי פליגי, התם בסברא פליגי -- in zimmun R' Meir reads ושבעת as drinking so the eating is an olive-bulk; in returning he likens return to impurity, an egg-bulk

objections.gloss_en: ורבי יהודה כביצה? והא איפכא שמעינן להו, דתנן: ורבי יהודה אומר זה וזה בכזית
